scope: All production TypeScript modules under workers/, both message-loop entrypoints, their application owners, and worker response protocols
implementedCorrections: A batch larger than 256 files is rejected before format inspection, destination creation, or conversion so File references, output names, and result state cannot grow without a hard ceiling.

Mixed-format and oversized batch rejection clears prior source-inspection, option, metric, warning, memory, destination, and result state so a rejected selection cannot retain the previous file's per-job objects.
All conversion-worker progress phases, warnings, and errors are centrally truncated before postMessage.
Direct-writer initialization and command errors use the same central text ceiling in addition to the existing fixed 4 KiB shared error channel.
The existing eight-warning UI ring now uses the shared named limit and truncates the batch-prefixed warning before retention.

completionClaim: A-08 is verified complete for the current production worker inventory.
